card.name: Start of long words like discontinuation
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word that is still unfinished, mostly "Dis" at the start of "discontinuation" in dose-modification table titles and headings. Also fires on pieces like "sal", "fl", "pl" and "Al" that begin words such as salivation, flammability, plasmapheresis and allopurinol.
